title: Dolly Factory Gui! *V1.4*
script:
do local Players=game:GetService("Players");local player=Players.LocalPlayer;local state={ESP=true,Enemies=true,Items=true,InstantPrompt=true,InfiniteStamina=true,PerfectMachine=true,AutoFarm=false};local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui");gui.Name="DevPanel";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui");local frame=Instance.new("Frame");frame.Size=UDim2.new(0,260,0,340);frame.Position=UDim2.new(0,20,0,20);frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,20,35);frame.BorderSizePixel=0;frame.Active=true;frame.Draggable=true;frame.Parent=gui;Instance.new("UICorner",frame).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12);local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Thickness=1;stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(90,110,180);stroke.Transparency=0.2;stroke.Parent=frame;local function tab(name,x) local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.new(0,80,0,28);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,x,0,10);b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,35,70);b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,230,255);b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextScaled=true;b.Text=name;b.Parent=frame;Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8);return b;end local espTab=tab("ESP",10);local tpTab=tab("TP",95);local helpTab=tab("HELP",180);local function page() local f=Instance.new("Frame");f.Size=UDim2.new(1, -20,1, -60);f.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,50);f.BackgroundTransparency=1;f.Visible=false;f.Parent=frame;return f;end local espPage=page();local tpPage=page();local helpPage=page();local function btn(parent,text,y) local b=Instance.new("TextButton");b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,38);b.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,y);b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,35,70);b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,230,255);b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextScaled=true;b.Text=text;b.Parent=parent;Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10);local s=Instance.new("UIStroke");s.Thickness=1;s.Color=Color3.fromRGB(90,110,180);s.Transparency=0.4;s.Parent=b;return b;end local enemies=workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies");local interacts=workspace:FindFirstChild("Interacts");local cache={};local function highlight(obj,color) if  not state.ESP then return;end if  not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return;end if (cache[obj] and cache[obj].Parent) then cache[obj].FillColor=color;return;end local h=Instance.new("Highlight");h.Adornee=obj;h.FillColor=color;h.OutlineColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);h.FillTransparency=0.3;h.Parent=obj;cache[obj]=h;end local function remove(obj) local h=cache[obj];if h then h:Destroy();cache[obj]=nil;end end local function process(obj) if  not state.ESP then return;end if  not enemies then return;end if (obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj:IsDescendantOf(enemies)) then if state.Enemies then highlight(obj,Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0));else remove(obj);end end end for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do process(v);end workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process);local toolsFolder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Tools");local labelCache={};local function createLabel(obj) if labelCache[obj] then return;end if  not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return;end local bill=Instance.new("BillboardGui");bill.Size=UDim2.new(0,100,0,30);bill.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0);bill.AlwaysOnTop=true;local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;text.Text=obj.Name;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);text.TextStrokeTransparency=0;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextScaled=true;text.Parent=bill;bill.Parent=obj;labelCache[obj]=bill;end local function removeLabel(obj) if labelCache[obj] then labelCache[obj]:Destroy();labelCache[obj]=nil;end end local function processTools(obj) if  not state.ESP then return;end if  not toolsFolder then return;end if ((obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("Tool")) and obj:IsDescendantOf(toolsFolder)) then local part=obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") ;if part then highlight(part,Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255));if  not labelCache[obj] then local bill=Instance.new("BillboardGui");bill.Size=UDim2.new(0,100,0,30);bill.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0);bill.AlwaysOnTop=true;local text=Instance.new("TextLabel");text.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);text.BackgroundTransparency=1;local displayName=obj.Name;if ((displayName=="Model") or (displayName=="Part")) then displayName="Item";end text.Text=displayName;text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);text.TextStrokeTransparency=0;text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;text.TextScaled=true;text.Parent=bill;bill.Parent=part;labelCache[obj]=bill;end end end end if toolsFolder then for _,v in pairs(toolsFolder:GetDescendants()) do processTools(v);end end workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) processTools(obj);end);local itemCollection=workspace:FindFirstChild("Interacts");itemCollection=itemCollection and itemCollection:FindFirstChild("ItemCollection") ;local itemCache={};local function highlightItem(obj) if  not state.ESP then return;end if  not state.Items then return;end if  not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return;end if (itemCache[obj] and itemCache[obj].Parent) then return;end local h=Instance.new("Highlight");h.Adornee=obj;h.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0);h.OutlineColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);h.FillTransparency=0.3;h.Parent=obj;itemCache[obj]=h;end local function removeItem(obj) if itemCache[obj] then itemCache[obj]:Destroy();itemCache[obj]=nil;end end local function processItems(obj) if  not itemCollection then return;end if (obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") and obj.Parent:IsA("BasePart")) then obj=obj.Parent;end if (obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj:IsDescendantOf(itemCollection)) then if (state.ESP and state.Items) then highlightItem(obj);else removeItem(obj);end end end if itemCollection then for _,v in pairs(itemCollection:GetDescendants()) do processItems(v);end end workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(processItems);local TRAIN_POS=Vector3.new( -631.83,8.34,532.8);local function hrp() local c=player.Character;return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ;end local function hasPrompt(part) for _,v in pairs(part:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return true;end end return false;end local function getClosestMachine() local h=hrp();if ( not h or  not interacts) then return;end local closest,dist=nil,math.huge;for _,obj in pairs(interacts:GetDescendants()) do if (obj:IsA("BasePart") and hasPrompt(obj)) then local d=(h.Position-obj.Position).Magnitude;if (d<dist) then dist=d;closest=obj;end end end return closest;end local map=workspace:WaitForChild("Map");local interact=map:WaitForChild("Interact");local activeCoils={};workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then if (obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name:lower():find("coil")) then table.insert(activeCoils,obj);end end end);workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(obj) if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then for i,v in ipairs(activeCoils) do if (v==obj) then table.remove(activeCoils,i);break;end end end end);local completedMachines={};local function getNextMachine() local h=hrp();if ( not h or  not interacts) then return;end local closest,dist=nil,math.huge;local foundAny=false;for _,obj in pairs(interacts:GetDescendants()) do if (obj:IsA("BasePart") and hasPrompt(obj)) then foundAny=true;if  not completedMachines[obj] then local d=(h.Position-obj.Position).Magnitude;if (d<dist) then dist=d;closest=obj;end end end end if (foundAny and  not closest) then completedMachines={};end return closest;end local function isEnemyNear(range) local h=hrp();if ( not h or  not enemies) then return false;end for _,obj in pairs(enemies:GetDescendants()) do if obj:IsA("BasePart") then local d=(h.Position-obj.Position).Magnitude;if (d<=range) then return true;end end end return false;end local function makeInstant(prompt) if  not state.InstantPrompt then return;end if  not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return;end prompt.HoldDuration=0;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;end for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do makeInstant(v);end workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj) if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then makeInstant(obj);end end);local decalId="rbxassetid://109881231491183";local function hasDecal(part) for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do if (child:IsA("Decal") and (child.Texture==decalId)) then return true;end end return false;end local function addDecals(part) for _,face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do local decal=Instance.new("Decal");decal.Texture=decalId;decal.Face=face;decal.Parent=part;end end local espBtn=btn(espPage,"ESP: ON",10);local enemyBtn=btn(espPage,"Enemies: ON",55);local instantBtn=btn(espPage,"INSTANT PROMPT: ON",100);local tpBtn=btn(tpPage,"TP MACHINE",10);local trainBtn=btn(tpPage,"TP TRAIN",55);local decalBtn=btn(tpPage,"SPAWN DECALS",100);local autofarmBtn=btn(tpPage,"AUTO FARM: OFF",145);local staminaBtn=btn(espPage,"STAMINA: ON",145);local machineBtn=btn(espPage,"MACHINE: ON",190);local helpTitle=Instance.new("TextLabel");helpTitle.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,30);helpTitle.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,10);helpTitle.BackgroundTransparency=1;helpTitle.Text="CREDITS / HELP";helpTitle.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,230,255);helpTitle.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;helpTitle.TextScaled=true;helpTitle.Parent=helpPage;local helpText=Instance.new("TextLabel");helpText.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,220);helpText.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,45);helpText.BackgroundTransparency=1;helpText.TextWrapped=true;helpText.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top;helpText.Text=[[
Help/Credits

ESP - highlights enemies
INSTANT PROMPT - removes hold delay
TP MACHINE - nearest interactable
TP TRAIN - fixed teleport
Autofarm - may sometimes break
made by nabnab on scriptblox!

]];helpText.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(160,180,220);helpText.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;helpText.TextSize=14;helpText.Parent=helpPage;local function show(p) espPage.Visible=false;tpPage.Visible=false;helpPage.Visible=false;p.Visible=true;end espTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() show(espPage);end);tpTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() show(tpPage);end);helpTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() show(helpPage);end);show(espPage);autofarmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.AutoFarm= not state.AutoFarm;autofarmBtn.Text="AUTO FARM: "   .. ((state.AutoFarm and "ON") or "OFF") ;if  not state.AutoFarm then completedMachines={};end end);espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.ESP= not state.ESP;espBtn.Text="ESP: "   .. ((state.ESP and "ON") or "OFF") ;if  not state.ESP then for _,h in pairs(cache) do if h then h:Destroy();end end cache={};for _,l in pairs(labelCache) do if l then l:Destroy();end end labelCache={};elseif toolsFolder then for _,v in pairs(toolsFolder:GetDescendants()) do processTools(v);end end end);enemyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.Enemies= not state.Enemies;enemyBtn.Text="Enemies: "   .. ((state.Enemies and "ON") or "OFF") ;end);instantBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.InstantPrompt= not state.InstantPrompt;instantBtn.Text="INSTANT PROMPT: "   .. ((state.InstantPrompt and "ON") or "OFF") ;end);tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() local h=hrp();local t=getClosestMachine();if (h and t) then h.CFrame=t.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0) ;end end);trainBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() local h=hrp();if h then h.CFrame=CFrame.new(TRAIN_POS + Vector3.new(0,3,0) );end end);decalBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if (obj:IsA("BasePart") and  not hasDecal(obj)) then addDecals(obj);end end end);local replicated=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");local BuffHandler=require(replicated.Shared.Modules.BuffHandler);local old_IsActive=BuffHandler.IsActive;BuffHandler.IsActive=function(self,buffname) if ((buffname=="InfiniteStamina") and state.InfiniteStamina) then return true;end return old_IsActive(self,buffname);end;staminaBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.InfiniteStamina= not state.InfiniteStamina;staminaBtn.Text="STAMINA: "   .. ((state.InfiniteStamina and "ON") or "OFF") ;end);machineBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() state.PerfectMachine= not state.PerfectMachine;machineBtn.Text="MACHINE: "   .. ((state.PerfectMachine and "ON") or "OFF") ;end);local MachineMinigame=require(player.PlayerScripts.Client.Interface.UIController.GameUI.MachineMinigame);local old_GetScore=MachineMinigame.GetMinigameScore;MachineMinigame.GetMinigameScore=function(self,...) if state.PerfectMachine then return "Perfect";end return old_GetScore(self,...);end;local pickupFolder=workspace:WaitForChild("Pickup");local function highlightAll(junkFolder) for _,obj in ipairs(junkFolder:GetDescendants()) do if (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) then if  not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") then local highlight=Instance.new("Highlight");highlight.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,105);highlight.OutlineColor=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,255);highlight.FillTransparency=0.5;highlight.OutlineTransparency=0;highlight.Adornee=obj;highlight.Parent=obj;end end end end local function monitorJunk(junkFolder) highlightAll(junkFolder);junkFolder.DescendantAdded:Connect(function() task.defer(function() highlightAll(junkFolder);end);end);end task.spawn(function() while true do local junkFolder=pickupFolder:FindFirstChild("Junk");if junkFolder then monitorJunk(junkFolder);junkFolder.AncestryChanged:Wait();end task.wait(0.5);end end);local TRAIN_DROP=Vector3.new( -730.215759, -0.546702385,524.382629);task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(0.2);if  not state.AutoFarm then continue;end local h=hrp();if  not h then continue;end if ( #activeCoils>0) then for i= #activeCoils,1, -1 do local prompt=activeCoils[i];if ( not prompt or  not prompt.Parent or  not prompt.Enabled) then table.remove(activeCoils,i);continue;end local part=prompt.Parent;if part:IsA("BasePart") then h.CFrame=part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,2,0) ;task.wait(0.05);fireproximityprompt(prompt);task.wait(0.15);end end continue;end local machine=getNextMachine();if  not machine then h.CFrame=CFrame.new(TRAIN_DROP + Vector3.new(0,0,0) );task.wait(0.25);h.CFrame=CFrame.new(TRAIN_POS + Vector3.new(0,3,0) );task.wait(1);continue;end h.CFrame=machine.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0) ;local working=true;while working and state.AutoFarm  do task.wait(0.1);if isEnemyNear(15) then h.CFrame=CFrame.new(TRAIN_DROP + Vector3.new(0,3,0) );task.wait(0.25);h.CFrame=CFrame.new(TRAIN_POS + Vector3.new(0,3,0) );task.wait(4);h.CFrame=machine.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0) ;end local foundPrompt=false;for _,v in pairs(machine:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then foundPrompt=true;fireproximityprompt(v);end end if  not foundPrompt then completedMachines[machine]=true;working=false;end end task.wait(0.5);end end); end
